title: Engineering Manager, Supply & Insights DnA
searchText: Engineering Manager, Supply & Insights DnA Airbnb Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. The Community You Will Join: Marketplaces Data & AI (DnA) is the AI/ML execution org for Airbnb's supply side. The team of ~54 engineers spans Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Machine Learning. Our mission: increase the inventory and discoverability of high-quality supply, and help hosts maximize their success on Airbnb. Supply & Insights DnA is one of four sub-orgs within Marketplaces DnA. The team builds the data products and intelligence systems that help hosts understand and grow their businesses on Airbnb's pricing strategy and competitive positioning. The Difference You Will Make: As Engineering Manager for Supply & Insights DnA, you will own three product areas that directly shape how hosts experience Airbnb and how Airbnb competes in the market. You will be accountable for: Host Insights Platform — The primary data product surface for Airbnb hosts: earnings forecasts, calendar analytics, performance benchmarks, and pricing signals. This team directly influences whether hosts understand their business, price competitively, and stay engaged on the platform. Competitive Intelligence (Meets/Beats) — The data program that determines whether Airbnb listings are priced competitively against Vrbo, Booking.com, and other platforms. Involves data acquisition partnerships, competitive signal processing, and analytics that directly inform Airbnb's pricing and monetization strategy. Pricing & Availability Data — Availability forecasts, supply/demand projections, and the datasets behind Smart Pricing and host pricing tools. This data is also a critical input to Finance and Strategy planning, giving the work broad internal reach and visibility. You will manage a team of data engineers, analytics engineers, and ML engineers across three groups. You will partner with Product Management, Data Science, and Product Engineering to define roadmaps, drive execution, and ship high-quality data products. You will also be stabilizing a team coming off a leadership transition — the ability to build trust quickly and create execution clarity is essential. A Typical Day: Partner with PM and DS counterparts on the host Insights roadmap — prioritizing features that improve host understanding, retention, and listing performance Drive execution across P&A data pipelines, competitive data ingestion, and Insights product features — unblocking dependencies across teams Review technical designs for pricing projection models, competitive data acquisition systems, and the host Insights analytics platform Manage and develop senior ICs and tech leads, ensuring strong ownership within each group Represent Supply & Insights DnA in cross-functional forums with Supply, Finance, and Pricing partners Monitor data quality, pipeline reliability, and model health — escalate risks and coverage gaps to the Director proactively Recruit and onboard engineering talent to fill capability gaps Your Expertise: 9+ years in the tech industry, 3-5+ years of engineering management BS, MS, or PhD in CS, Data Science, or related field Experience leading teams that build data products across multiple disciplines (data engineering, analytics engineering, ML) — not just one Experience building host- or user-facing analytics products — dashboards, insights tools, or performance reporting systems that surface data to non-technical end users Familiarity with pricing, marketplace, or supply/demand data systems — understanding of how pricing models and availability forecasts are built, maintained, and consumed by downstream teams Proven ability to operate in a matrixed environment, partnering across Product, Data Science, Finance, and Infrastructure Strong communication skills — comfortable translating technical tradeoffs to non-technical partners and representing team progress to senior leadership Experience building or stabilizing a team through a period of leadership change or growth Commitment to engineering excellence, Diversity, and Belonging Your Location: This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list . If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from. Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging: Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application. How We'll Take Care of You: Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.
